questions.stem: What does the gradient of a velocity-time graph represent?
questions.explanation: The gradient of a velocity-time graph equals change in velocity divided by change in time, which is acceleration. A steeper positive gradient means greater acceleration.

questions.stem: What does the area under a velocity-time graph represent?
questions.explanation: The area under a velocity-time graph represents the displacement of the object. If the velocity is always positive, this is the same as the distance travelled.
